title: Voice Tuner Walkthrough
subtitle: Test voice changes safely before applying live

scenes.caption: Open Voice Tuner and show the safe lab.
scenes.narration: Voice Tuner is the safe testing lab. Option A is the current live voice. Option B is the sandbox version. Nothing changes live unless you explicitly apply it live.

scenes.caption: Show the voice, format, model, prompt, and feedback controls.
scenes.narration: Choose the voice, choose the format, run the A B test, then add feedback to the sandbox until the voice feels right.
